placement.statement: Place each claim in the lowest room that owns it. A claim spanning several rooms belongs to their lowest common ancestor room. When that room does not exist, create it rather than dropping knowledge somewhere it does not belong.

trust_layers.statement: Human-ingested Context is the authoritative layer. Conflicts are preserved as new Context or escalated to the user, never overwritten.
Distill-produced Context carries a distill: source ref and yields to the human layer whenever they disagree.
